title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: 30 vendors per page, none repeated or skipped
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Between 31 and 90 vendors have overdue bills on today's date.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/P Unpaid Invoices is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  2. Count the vendors in the CSV (each name once).
  3. Count the vendors on the first page and note the last one.
  4. Go to the next page (or scroll until the next ones load).
  5. Read every page to the end, writing down each vendor's name.
  6. Click the "Open Balance" header.
  7. Read every page again, writing down each name.
  8. In the Past due filter, tick "1-30 days" and "91+ days".
  9. Read every page again, writing down each name.
  10. Read the Totals row on each page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the CSV downloads.
  • Step 2: note the number of vendors (for example 46).
  • Step 3: exactly 30 vendors.
  • Step 4: the next page starts with the vendor that comes right after the last one of the first page, not a repeat.
  • Step 5: every vendor appears exactly once and the count equals the CSV's.
  • Step 6: the rows sort by Open Balance, largest first.
  • Step 7: in this sort too, every vendor appears exactly once and none is missing.
  • Step 8: the report reloads with only those two ranges.
  • Step 9: every vendor left by the filter appears exactly once; none repeats between pages.
  • Step 10: the Totals row reads the same on every page and adds up every row the filters leave, not only the rows on that page.

Whether the next 30 come by page buttons or by scrolling is question 6; story SV-11531 still says "Paging (30 rows per page)" for every report, PRD v5 is followed.

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R18: “The Totals row always adds up exactly the rows the filters leave (customer or vendor, Past due, Location), on screen on every page, in the PDF and in the CSV. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices this fixes today's Totals row, which ignores the customer or vendor filter.”
